title: Interpreting Supervised Pairwise Graph Representations: Local Evidence, Confounding, and Provable Post-hoc Correction
abstract: arXiv:2610.32611v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Supervised pairwise graph representations convert pairwise predictive relations into sample-specific graphs, but graph-level accuracy does not by itself show that higher-order topology carries the signal. In a controlled Transformer error-detection task, supervised pairwise graphs outperform attention-as-adjacency (ROC-AUC $0.839$ versus $0.559$; the comparable no-confidence pair is $0.687$ versus $0.559$), but their apparent advantage over model confidence disappears after controlling for sequence length, which is almost perfectly recoverable from the pooled hidden state ($R^2=0.9995$). On published HCP Emotion ensemble graphs, signed node aggregation already acts as an ensemble of supervised pairwise predictions. translated_title: 解读监督式成对图表示：局部证据、混杂因素与可证明的事后修正
translated_abstract: 监督式成对图表示将成对预测关系转化为样本特定的图结构，但图级别的准确率本身并不能证明高阶拓扑结构承载了预测信号。在一个受控的Transformer错误检测任务中，监督式成对图的性能优于“注意力即邻接矩阵”方法（ROC-AUC为0.839对0.559；可比的无置信度版本为0.687对0.559），但在控制序列长度之后，它们相对于模型置信度的表面优势消失了——序列长度几乎可以从池化隐藏状态中被完美恢复（R²=0.9995）。在已发表的HCP Emotion集成图上，带符号的节点聚合本身已经起到了监督式成对预测集成的作用。仅凭边幅值进行预测接近随机水平；拓扑感知的增强方法对ROC-AUC的改变最多只有0.004，其中只有符号分离度在所有测试的图规模上显示出微小的正向变化，而经过验证集调优的三（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过受控实验与混杂因素分析揭示，监督式成对图表示的表面性能优势可能源于序列长度等混杂因素而非高阶图拓扑本身，并提出可证明的事后修正方法来区分真实的局部证据与虚假关联。
en_tdlr: This study uses controlled experiments and confounder analysis to reveal that the apparent advantage of supervised pairwise graph representations may stem from confounders such as sequence length rather than higher-order graph topology itself, and proposes provable post-hoc corrections to distinguish genuine local evidence from spurious associations.
